_note: SCHOOL KIT TILE BLOCK — structure copied 1:1 from smiggle.co.uk's 'READY. SET. BACK TO SCHOOL.' block, verified from a rendered 375px screenshot on 17 Aug 2026. Six tiles, two per row, price-band tile first and carrying the only badge.

_smiggle_reference.heading: READY. SET. BACK TO SCHOOL.
_smiggle_reference.observed: Tile 1 is the price band and is the only tile with a roundel badge ('HOT OFFER', blue circle, top-right). Tile 1's image shows a COMPLETE KIT (bag + lunchbox + pencil case + bottle) while every other tile shows a SINGLE item — that contrast is how the bundle reads as more value at a glance. Labels sit inside the tile below the image, centred and underlined. Tile panel is a light warm grey, product photo centred on it.
_smiggle_reference.note: Smiggle rotates tiles 5 and 6 by campaign — on 16 Aug they were 'School Stationery' and 'School Pencil Cases'. Ours must therefore be data-driven, never hardcoded.

_UNCONFIRMED_PRICING: The four ₹ bands below are INFERRED from bottom-up MRP arithmetic in research/market/price-bands.md, NOT confirmed by Sam. Every component price needs a live re-check before launch — one spot-check already found a Faber-Castell geometry box listed at ₹100 that is actually ₹95, i.e. rounded UP, which inflates the saving. DO NOT show a savings figure to a customer until Sam signs off the kit contents and the MRP totals.
